dict.string: ClearSpace reads your calendar events on this device to find old events you may want to remove. Events are only deleted after you confirm.
ClearSpace reads your calendar events on this device to find old events you may want to remove. Events are only deleted after you confirm.
ClearSpace reads your contacts on this device to find duplicates. A contact is only deleted after you review it and confirm.
ClearSpace uses Face ID to keep your Private Vault locked.
ClearSpace saves compressed copies of videos and restores photos from your Private Vault to your photo library.
ClearSpace scans your photo library on this device to find similar photos, screenshots and large videos so you can review and remove them. Nothing leaves your iPhone.
